decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line changelog entry [ev-b47e5003a748]. It says known interim resources are now excluded by default and marks the change as breaking ("!"). It does not say which resources count as interim, what the exclusion affects, or what happens to an operator who does nothing. The proposed statement's claims about sync and status behaviour and its "high" severity are not in the evidence. A breaking marker alone could also point to a failure kind, so the behavior-change kind cannot be confirmed either. We need the 3.0 upgrade guide section or the PR (#20013/#21635) that explains the new default exclusions and their effect on existing Applications.
